Carmen Diaz: Quick follow-up from today's PM: recurring tail-latency regressions around model rehydration. We need clear owners, concise RACI, and tickets. Keep fixes scoped first, escalate to a sprint only if pattern persists. :spiral_calendar:
Ethan Stone: I can own the initial mitigation (priming + conservative rehydrate window). Will open a Jira and aim for a 10bd target.
Rohan Gupta: I'll take instrumentation and the recurrence tracker entry. Will add a metric for "post-rehydrate 95p" and a 5m alert.
Priya Nair: I'll own rollout gating and acceptance criteria. Need a rollback threshold and canary plan.
Carmen Diaz: Split sounds right. Two tickets: INF-10021 (hotfix: priming + throttle) and INF-10022 (design: rehydrate lifecycle). Tag both pm-followup and recurring-incident.
Ethan Stone: Creating INF-10021 now  INF-10021 - rehydrate priming + throttle. Target: 10bd.
alert-bot: New Jira created by Ethan: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-10021 (INF-10021)
Rohan Gupta: Created INF-10022 and linked as dependent. INF-10022 will cover warm-start strategies, priming caches, and telemetry improvements. Target: 3w.
alert-bot: New Jira created by Rohan: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-10022 (INF-10022)
Priya Nair: RACI draft: R: Ethan (INF-10021), R: Rohan (INF-10022), A: Carmen (PM), C: Priya (rollout gating) + Eng-oncall, I: Support + CS. Thoughts?
Ethan Stone: Hotfix plan (brief): 1) implement cache priming job that runs for new instances 2) small request-throttle during initial 30s after scale-up 3) unit + smoke tests 4) internal canary.
Rohan Gupta: I'll add "post-rehydrate 95p" and a derived metric "rehydrate-kv-hit-rate". Suggest alert: 95p latency > 400ms for 5m OR KV-hit-rate drop > 35% for 2m.
Priya Nair: Rollout plan: internal canary -> beta orgs -> broad. Rollback rule: if error-rate > 0.6% for 10m or OOMs occur, rollback immediately. I'll script the canary and add rollback hooks.
Carmen Diaz: Checkpoints: 72h status update, demo after 7bd, full sign-off after 10bd. Handoff rule: if owner out >4bd, escalate to rotation lead (Priya). Add note in ticket template.
Ethan Stone: Assigned INF-10021 to myself and set due date. Added pm-followup label and linked INF-10022.
Rohan Gupta: Assigned INF-10022 to myself. Adding tracker entry for recurring incidents with links to both tickets.
Priya Nair: I'll add acceptance tests to INF-10021: synthetic ramp that verifies tail-latency < 300ms and KV-hit-rate > 70% after 2m.
Carmen Diaz: Also, let's capture a short log example for the ticket: ```
[2026-05-02T11:03:12Z] WARN rehydrate: worker=12 priming=false kv_hit=false latency=520ms
[2026-05-02T11:03:13Z] ERROR request-handler: status=504 reason=rehydrate-timeout
```
Ethan Stone: Pasted log sample into INF-10021 and added a short perf test plan.
Rohan Gupta: I'll add dashboard tiles and an alert runbook snippet to INF-10022.
Priya Nair: Scheduling canary for next Tue in Dedicated once Ethan has a test build. Will add automated rollback if thresholds breached.
Carmen Diaz: Final owner map: Ethan (INF-10021), Rohan (INF-10022), Priya (canary/rollback). Everyone add Jira assignees and update due dates. Post short updates here and link PRs. If the recurrence continues after rollout we'll propose a 2-week remediation sprint. Ping me @Carmen if blocked. :white_check_mark:
